EEGCoordinateSystemDescription: RAS head coordinates: +X right, +Y anterior, +Z superior; origin at the midpoint of the BESA template LPA/RPA, nasion defining +Y. Supplied spherical BESA positions were rigidly transformed using the matching standard-10-5-cap385.elp template landmarks. CapTrak names the coordinate convention only; no CapTrak device or individual digitization was used. All participants share template positions. VEOG/HEOG rows remain transformed source placeholders, not scalp EEG electrodes.
AnatomicalLandmarkCoordinateSystemDescri: Inferred BESA template landmarks in the same head frame as the electrodes; not measured participant anatomy.
